method.execution: Native Electron, real dashboard ProjectListItem click via its actual handler; return via browser history; first open separate, then three warm reopens. Dataset processes run sequentially. No CPU profiler in reported latency batch. Native immutable resource cache performs its checksum checks. Native preview process enabled.
method.offline: API responses and exact dependency bodies replayed locally. Identity fixed to fixture account, no live authentication, sockets, project writes or native draft bridge. Default fit-all camera; does not replay normal App saved camera. These numbers are not live end-to-end durations.
method.boundaries: canvas-revealed and all-frames-rendered are program markers. detectedReadyMs is a polling upper bound, not precise visual/interaction readiness. Trace demonstrates paint can occur after reveal. Overlapping phase durations must not be added.
method.discarded: Browser-UA trial was not a Desktop-cache measurement. Concurrent verified trials were excluded because their workloads overlapped. Earlier native trials and CPU-profiled runs are supporting evidence, not pooled into the final sequential batch.
